text: my_free_busy exists as a separate tool (not a restricted mode of free_busy) because Stavrobot grants permissions per tool, and the user gives it to a subagent that talks to third parties in a Signal chat. free_busy takes any calendar IDs, which would let chat participants see colleagues' availability. The Google freeBusy API was rejected for this tool: it reports non-working time (the user's recurring 'I don't work Mondays' blocker, annual leave) as busy, but those are free for personal scheduling. User conventions behind the rules: annual leave is entered as an ~8 working-hour outOfOffice block (not all-day); the Monday blocker is an ordinary recurring event 12:00-20:00 Athens, not outOfOffice; out-of-office auto-declines meetings on leave days, so declined/unanswered meetings inside leave are free but accepted ones win over leave. Output and errors must never reveal event details, since the consumer is an untrusted chat.
author: Stavros Korokithakis <hi@stavros.io>
